4. Loaded retention and relocking are not a command

For a SEPARATE straight small-deflection service case in the same introduced
section, 10 N tip force plus self-weight give7.63274 mm initial tip deflection,
rotation0.0222976 rad and root moment7.0601 N m. E>=381.637 MPa would meet10 mm
in this geometry with no other compliance. This is not a curved-structure,
connection or whole-program-class certificate.

Under fixed service loads in the linear exchange model, additional tip creep is
  delta_creep = delta_elastic * integral a(t)dt.
An additional1 mm over24 h permits a_dark<=1.51637e-6/s if there is no activation
tail. With the introduced a_on=0.1/s, the corresponding necessary rate contrast
is65946.9. This is a conditional time-scale requirement, not an obtained
photocatalyst, an optical contrast ratio or a universal material bound.

A finite deactivation tail matters even if the ultimate dark state is good.
Take a_dark=1e-7/s and, after an off command,
  a(t)=a_dark+(a_on-a_dark)*exp(-0.01*t).
The 24 h accumulated activity after supported waiting t_wait is
  a_dark*T + (a_on-a_dark)/0.01 * exp(-0.01*t_wait)
             * (1-exp(-0.01*T)).
At300 s waiting it causes3.86606 mm added creep; satisfying the1 mm budget needs
440.325 s supported waiting. At600 s it gives0.255143 mm. The ideal dark term
alone contributes0.0659469 mm. The zero-wait linear diagnostic reaches a rotation
outside the introduced0.1-rad screen and is not a predicted real final shape.

A robot may retain the body until exchange is truly inhibited, but its occupancy,
support, source state, sensing, cooling or chemical restoration count. Light off,
a returned controller flag or one local pressure reading does not establish this
whole physical state. This is an explicit possible control-and-support sequence,
not an imposed sensor method or qualified hardware.
